senses.gloss: m. (גָּעַל) the cleaning of an impure vessel by means of boiling water (Num. XXXI, 23), v. הַגְעָלָה.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 97a:5">Zeb. 97ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 76a:5">Ab. Zar. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>כל יום … ג׳ לחבירו</he> every day the boiling done in the sacred vessel is the means of absorbing the soakings of the previous day.—Pl. <he>גִּיעוּלִים</he>, constr. <he>גִּיעוּלֵי</he>; (<he>גוים</he>, <he>עכו״ם</he>) <he>ג׳ גכרים</he> vessels of gentiles which require cleaning with boiling water before they may be used by Jews. Ib. 67ᵇ; 75ᵇ; a. fr.
